methodology: Opening/closing rank computed directly from every candidate row with a real Round 3 allotment in the source PDF, grouped by institute + specialty + ALLOTTED category (not candidate category). Specialty labels merge M.D./M.S. wording variants of the same subject, but keep NBEMS/DNB and Diploma tracks separate from the MD/MS track, since those are different training pathways with different closing ranks. PwD variants folded into their base category. Not split by quota (AI/state/ management etc.) -- most college+specialty+category cells already have very few candidates, and splitting further would fragment them past usefulness.
